notes: The financial year runs 2025/26 and ends 30 June 2026. Several items were not credited. The XcytoMatic customer forum and conference attendance are customer knowledge-sharing and marketing, not external education. Partnerships with Tecan, Hamilton and Roche are commercial integration and collaboration agreements, which is a trap. The minimum 40% gender target for management was missed, and its deadline was postponed to 2028/29. The pay transparency initiative is a compliance-driven equal-pay effort and was not scored. Headcount fell from 192 to 174. No concerns were reported through the whistleblower scheme. The company is outside CSRD scope and points to its website for its policies, but the report itself discusses the social and diversity areas in enough detail for coverage to be sufficient.
